title: Spectator Gui
features:
This script allows you to choose between yourself (me), a specific player (put the player's name), or a random player (random).

It also has an arrow system to quickly switch from one player to another, and it even includes a system to either spectate the player in an orbital way (just like you do with your own player normally) or see the direct POV of the selected player.

Even, there is an uncheckable option, which allows you to see the selected player's inventory, and their equipped item if any is equipped.

DISCLAIMER: The script was partially assisted by artificial intelligence, expect mistakes.
